name: Ring of Mind Shielding

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Magic can't read your thoughts, tell if you lie, or learn your alignment or creature type.
text: You are shielded from any magic that would let others read your thoughts, tell whether you are lying, or learn your alignment or creature type, and creatures can speak with you telepathically only with your permission. A Magic action makes the ring imperceptible; it stays hidden until you spend another Magic action to reveal it, take it off, or die. If you die wearing it, your soul passes into the ring unless another soul already resides there, and you may stay inside or move on to the afterlife. While your soul dwells in the ring, you can communicate telepathically with whoever wears it.
